Toxic_Spore_Cap_Epidermis.description: An outer layer consisting of massive, deeply colored basidiospore-producing caps. Any physical blow to the entity causes these caps to violently rupture, billowing blinding, necrotic spores into the attacker's lungs.

Bioluminescent_Slime_Sheath.description: A thick, continuously oozing layer of phosphorescent fungal slime. It illuminates the pitch dark of the Underdark to attract prey, while causing slashing weapons to glance harmlessly off the entity's body.
